To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the transport of newly synthesized cell surface glyco- proteins from the TGN to the plasma membrane is mediated by carrier vesicles and can be reconstituted in a cell-free system.
we have reconstituted the formation of carrier vesicles that transport cell surface glycoprotein from the TGN to the plasma membrane.
we have isolated a vesicle fraction that is derived from the trans-Goigi network and that contains proteins that are involved in vesicular transport.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of a vesicle fraction that is involved in the transport of newly synthesized cell surface glyco-proteins from the TGN to the plasma membrane.
the molecular mechanism of the transport of cell surface molecules from the TGN to the plasma membrane.
the isolation of exocytic transport vesicles from Bovine Kidney (BHK) cells and their characterization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the vesicles isolated in this study represent a population of exocytic transport carriers from the trans-Goli network.
the immunoisolated exocytic carrier from the TGN is a vesicle with a highly simplified protein composition.
these immunoisolated exocytic vesicles represent the first example of a reconstituted exocytic carrier from a eucaryotic cell.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
exocytic vesicle carriers can be isolated in a highly purified state from a cell-free system and can be used to study the molecular mechanism of vesicle formation.
we have developed a system in which the transport vesicles from the TGN to the plasma membrane are reconstituted and isolated.
we have isolated and characterized a carrier vesicle from a eukaryotic cell that mediates the delivery of newly synthesized cell surface glycosylated proteins to the plasma membrane.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a cell-free system to study the molecular mechanism of exocytic vesicle formation.
we can isolate exocytic carrier membranes in a relatively pure form.
the vesicles were enriched for the newly synthesized plasma membrane glycoproteins and that they were depleted in Golgi proteins.
